verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no user-configurable automation feature, such as scheduled or recurring tasks or rules that run in the background. The closest items are adjacent: automatic monthly fee wiring and automatic chargeback deductions are fixed platform behaviors, webhooks are event-notification building blocks, and the Mirakl connector automates one specific marketplace integration rather than letting users set up their own automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
